cards.ex: There's always a flurry of activity in the kitchen before Thanksgiving dinner.
cards.exUz: Shukronalik kuni kechki ovqatidan oldin oshxonada doimo jadal harakat bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Bayram oldidan yoki paytida bo'ladigan juda ko'p tezkor va hayajonli harakatlar.

cards.ex: We'll kick off the festivities with a fireworks display.
cards.exUz: Biz bayramni mushakbozlik bilan boshlaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Bayram yoki tadbirning boshlanishini nishonlash, odatda qandaydir marosim bilan.

cards.ex: Her graduation is definitely a reason to rejoice.
cards.exUz: Uning bitiruvi, albatta, quvonishga sabab.
cards.uzDef: Baxtli bo'lish va nishonlash uchun asos.

cards.ex: I was right in the thick of it, helping with all the last-minute preparations.
cards.exUz: Men eng qizg'inida edim, barcha so'nggi daqiqadagi tayyorgarliklarga yordam berardim.
cards.uzDef: Voqea yoki tadbirning eng qizg'in, eng band qismida bo'lish.

cards.ex: The wedding was a grand affair, with hundreds of guests.
cards.exUz: To'y yuzlab mehmonlar bilan dabdabali tadbir bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Katta, dabdabali va muhim tadbir.

cards.ex: Let's eat, drink, and make merry!
cards.exUz: Keling, yeymiz, ichamiz va xursandchilik qilamiz!
cards.uzDef: Quvnoq bo'lish va bayram qilish.

cards.ex: The peace treaty marked a turning point in the country's history.
cards.exUz: Tinchlik shartnomasi mamlakat tarixida burilish nuqtasini belgiladi.
cards.uzDef: Muhim o'zgarish yoki rivojlanishning boshlanishini nishonlash.

cards.ex: For many, the New Year is a time of reflection on the past year.
cards.exUz: Ko'pchilik uchun Yangi yil o'tgan yil haqida fikrlash vaqti.
cards.uzDef: O'tmish haqida o'ylash va kelajakka rejalashtirish uchun ajratilgan vaqt.

cards.ex: The fireworks display was a feast for the eyes.
cards.exUz: Mushakbozlik ko'zni quvontiruvchi edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda chiroyli va ko'rishga yoqimli bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: The crowd burst into song as the clock struck midnight.
cards.exUz: Soat yarim tunda jiringlaganda olomon birdaniga qo'shiq aytib yubordi.
cards.uzDef: Birdaniga qo'shiq aytishni boshlash.

cards.ex: Everyone was in high spirits after the victory.
cards.exUz: G'alabadan keyin hamma ko'tarinki kayfiyatda edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda xursand va quvnoq kayfiyatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: Their engagement is definitely a cause for celebration.
cards.exUz: Ularning unashtiruvi, albatta, nishonlashga sabab.
cards.uzDef: Quvonish va bayram qilish uchun asos.

cards.ex: The festival marks the start of the harvest season.
cards.exUz: Festival hosil mavsumining boshlanishini belgilaydi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning boshlanishini nishonlash.

cards.ex: It's easy to get swept away by the excitement of the festival.
cards.exUz: Festivalning hayajoniga berilib ketish oson.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga juda hayajonlanib, unutib yubormoq.

cards.ex: The opening ceremony set the stage for a week of celebrations.
cards.exUz: Ochilish marosimi bir haftalik bayramlar uchun zamin yaratdi.
cards.uzDef: Keyingi voqealarga tayyorgarlik ko'rmoq.

cards.ex: The coronation was marked with great pomp and ceremony.
cards.exUz: Toj kiydirish katta dabdaba va marosim bilan nishonlandi.
cards.uzDef: Katta dabdaba va tantana bilan nishonlamoq.

cards.ex: The marketplace was bustling with activity on the day of the festival.
cards.exUz: Festival kuni bozor faoliyatga to'la edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda ko'p faoliyat va harakat bilan to'la bo'lish.

cards.ex: The crowd broke out in cheers when the team scored the winning goal.
cards.exUz: Jamoa g'alaba golini urganda olomon xursandchilik qichqiriqlarini boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Birdaniga xursandchilik qichqiriqlarini boshlash.

cards.ex: The whole town was in a festive mood during the Christmas season.
cards.exUz: Rojdestvo mavsumida butun shahar bayramona kayfiyatda edi.
cards.uzDef: Xursand va quvnoq kayfiyat.

cards.ex: The long weekend provides a chance to unwind and relax.
cards.exUz: Uzoq dam olish kunlari dam olish va stressdan xalos bo'lish imkoniyatini beradi.
cards.uzDef: Dam olish va stressdan xalos bo'lish imkoniyati.

cards.ex: Christmas is often seen as a time for giving.
cards.exUz: Rojdestvo ko'pincha berish vaqti sifatida ko'riladi.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarga yordam berish va sovg'alar berish vaqti.

cards.ex: The decorations added a touch of elegance to the party.
cards.exUz: Bezaklar ziyofatga bir oz nafosat qo'shdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga ozgina miqdorda qo'shmoq.

cards.ex: It's my birthday, so it's a reason to splurge on a nice dinner.
cards.exUz: Bugun mening tug'ilgan kunim, shuning uchun yaxshi kechki ovqatga isrofgarchilik qilishga sabab.
cards.uzDef: Odatdagidan ko'ra ko'proq pul sarflashga sabab bo'ladigan narsa.

cards.ex: The monument was built in memory of the soldiers who died in the war.
cards.exUz: Yodgorlik urushda halok bo'lgan askarlarning xotirasiga qurilgan.
cards.uzDef: O'tgan odamni xotirlash va hurmat ko'rsatish maqsadida.

cards.ex: The anniversary will be marked with various festivities.
cards.exUz: Yillik sana turli bayramlar bilan nishonlanadi.
cards.uzDef: Bayramlar va tadbirlar bilan nishonlamoq.

cards.ex: Their wedding was a truly memorable occasion.
cards.exUz: Ularning to'yi haqiqatan ham esda qolarli voqea bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Eslab qolishga arziydigan muhim va quvonchli voqea.

cards.ex: We ring out the old and ring in the new every New Year's Eve.
cards.exUz: Har Yangi yil arafasida biz eski bilan xayrlashamiz va yangisini kutib olamiz.
cards.uzDef: Eski yilni tugatish va yangisini kutib olish.

cards.ex: The end of the year is often a time for reflection on what you've accomplished.
cards.exUz: Yilning oxiri ko'pincha erishgan yutuqlaringiz haqida fikrlash vaqti.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishni eslab, kelajakni rejalashtirish uchun vaqt.

cards.ex: In the spirit of giving, we're collecting donations for the local shelter.
cards.exUz: Saxovat ruhida biz mahalliy boshpanalar uchun xayr-ehson yig'yapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning asosiy g'oyasi yoki maqsadiga muvofiq.

cards.ex: Music is an integral part of many celebrations.
cards.exUz: Musiqa ko'plab bayramlarning ajralmas qismidir.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning muhim va zaruriy qismi.
